responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_type_ir/src/relate/combine.rs: Defines the shared type/const combination logic used by relating operations that can emit obligations. It handles direct inference-variable unification and instantiation, selects when to structurally recurse versus defer alias and unevaluated-const relationships into predicates/goals, applies typing-mode-specific handling for opaque types, and reports sort mismatches or unexpected inference forms. compiler/rustc_type_ir/src/relate/solver_relating.rs: Implements the solver-facing `TypeRelation` that relates types, regions, consts, generic arguments, and binders under a variance and parameter environment while collecting resulting solver goals. It owns the relation state for the new trait solver, including alias-structural mode, ambient variance, emitted goals, and a cache to avoid repeating equivalent relations, and exposes `InferCtxtLike` extension entry points for general relating and equality that structurally relates aliases.
